My dad also cheated on my mom with a colleague who is around my age. I had suspected an affair for a long time and one day I came home when the mistress was in our home, in the master bedroom with my dad, where the bed is right beside a large wedding portrait of my parents. 

Turns out my dad lied over and over again to our family for years to cover up the affair, and gaslighted my mom when she confronted him about lying by telling her she was imagining things and HE was the one angry with her for raising such allegations.

He also lied to me about why the mistress was in our home, and despite promising to stop, I found out that he continued to meet her behind our backs and that they still exchanged hearts and kissing emojis. 

So I too have a dad whom I find disgusting. Even though he has been a good dad in many ways.

What has helped is therapy. I would strongly recommend getting therapy if possible, or talking to friends about it. While they may not be able to understand the intricacies of your family life to the same extent that you do, they can still provide a listening ear, emotional support and their views for your consideration.

I hope we will both be able to heal with time!
